name: dsa_opus5_fused_mma
author: dsa-opus5
description: Hand-written fused CUDA kernel for DSA sparse MLA decode: a speculative slot-ordered KV gather that starts before the index prefix scan finishes (and falls back when a row is not suffix-padded), split-K flash decoding with mma.m16n8k16 bf16 tensor cores over padded shared memory, and an in-kernel combine whose release word carries the per-chunk lse, so the whole op is a single launch.
